target: PSA aggregate annual palay yield, t/ha, at province level
limitations: Retrospective aggregate estimates, not measured field yields or crop damage.
Six provinces only; geographic holdouts share regional weather and are not fully independent.
Historical PSA revisions/publication lags are not reconstructed; operational as-of availability is unverified.
Rolling one-year forecasts use each preceding year's observed yield, including prior test years; not a fixed multi-year forecast.
No climate, management, planting-date or HDF5 predictors; this model cannot rank planting plans.
No calibrated intervals, prospective validation or agronomic review.
Holdout chosen before this run, after data acquisition; no hyperparameter tuning on test scores.
